name: attachment
useFor: Use for files attached to a message, a purchase or a form: receipts, invoices, exports. Set state (idle, uploading, processing, error, done) and say what is happening in AttachmentDescription. Add AttachmentTrigger to open the file, AttachmentAction for remove, retry or download, and AttachmentGroup for a row that scrolls.
constraints: More than two actions on one file
source: Extrapolated from Agentcard: the white key (agentcard-website .v7-btn), the window bar's sky and blue (.v7-windowbar) and the guides' light bevel

title: Attachment
description: A file on a small white key: a sky tile with a blue glyph, the name in the display face and its size or status below; dashed while waiting, red when it failed.
